caseName: Clinton v. City of New York
caseNameFull: Clinton, President of the United States v. City of New York

opinions.text: D. C. D. C. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 522 U. S. 1144.] Motion of appellees for divided argument granted to be divided as follows: appellants, 30 minutes; New York City appellees, 15 minutes; Snake River appellees, 15 minutes. Request for additional time for oral argument denied.
